bug_info.bug_desc: When RdataMuxCheck=0, the error signals oh_raddr_a_err and oh_raddr_b_err are declared but never assigned a value in the gen_no_rdata_mux_check generate block. This causes undriven signal warnings during linting (e.g., Verilator UNDRIVEN warning). The signals are used in the err_o assignment but lack a default value when the one-hot mux check feature is disabled.
bug_info.fix_hint: Add explicit assignments of 1'b0 to oh_raddr_a_err and oh_raddr_b_err within the gen_no_rdata_mux_check generate block, similar to how oh_we_err is handled in the gen_no_wren_check block when WrenCheck=0.
